description: Composição multi-referência: combina até três papéis de imagem (personagem, objeto, estilo) numa geração única. Regime `composition`. Uso: colocar um objeto num cenário com um sujeito específico; combinar estilo de uma imagem com pose de outra.

ask_before.prompt: Descrição do sujeito referenciado, para servir de âncora textual à imagem de referência. Não repete a foto — resume traços que precisam sobreviver.
Marcas do sujeito referenciado, para o modelo saber o que é identidade.
Expressão desejada — pode diferir das referências (parte variável).
O que precisa sobreviver da referência (identidade facial, marcas, tom de pele).
O que pode variar (pose, ambiente, vestuário, iluminação).

URLs públicas das imagens de referência. Ordem sugerida: identidade, depois objetos, depois estilo. Máximo 5 de identidade, 6 de objetos e 3 de estilo — 14 no total pela API Gemini; 8 no total pelo /nano-banana da Higgsfield.
Frase de abertura da composição — o que a cena final representa.

subject.vellus_hair: vellus at the jaw preserved from the reference

wardrobe.garment: as visible on the identity reference; changes only where character.variable authorises
wardrobe.fabric: as visible on the identity reference
wardrobe.weave: as visible on the identity reference
tension_creases: as visible on the identity reference

in_focus: the near eye of the composed subject
out_of_focus: the far eye and the shoulder soften progressively

optics.bokeh_character: smooth centre with mild cat-eye deformation at the frame edges

lighting.shadow_direction: falls down and camera-right, consistent for every element in the composed scene

catchlight.shape: a soft-cornered octagon mirroring the octabox
catchlight.far_eye: smaller and dimmer in the far eye

skin.pore_scale: at true pore scale for the framing, preserved from the identity reference
skin.specular_zones: sebum sheen on the T-zone as visible in the identity reference; the T-zone stays measurably brighter than the cheeks
skin.subsurface: subsurface scattering reddens the ear rims and outer nostrils as in the reference

render.colour_profile: matched across all referenced sources; if references disagree, the identity reference sets the palette
render.highlight_rolloff: gradual, without clipping any specular from the objects reference
render.black_point: the deepest shadow near 8 percent luminance rather than pure black
render.grain: fine luminance grain consistent with ISO 50

frame.composition: subject centred with the composed object or style element sharing the frame without occluding the face
frame.headroom: moderate headroom, roughly 8 percent of frame height above the crown

character.reference_chain: if this composition seeds a series, feed the approved output back as the identity reference on the next turn instead of the original identity reference

imperfection_budget.specific: one stray hair falls across the forehead, matching the halo of stray strands visible on the identity reference

defaults.capture_reality: A single composed frame that combines the declared references under the identity reference's lighting and palette
avoid: alteration of any preserved facial mark
shift in skin tone from the identity reference
shadow direction disagreement between subject and composed elements
second light direction on the face

example_answers.meta.user_request: quero uma composição da minha personagem (imagem 1) segurando o produto (imagem 2), com iluminação de estúdio
example_answers.scene.headline: Composed studio portrait: identity reference holding the object reference, waist-up
example_answers.subject.description: A 29-year-old woman with warm mid-brown skin, dark eyes and long straight dark hair pulled back, as preserved from the identity reference
subject.asymmetries: the left eyebrow sits marginally higher than the right, as in the reference
the right corner of the mouth carries a longer smile line, as in the reference
subject.preserved_marks: a 3mm mole on the left cheekbone, as in the reference
two faint freckles at the bridge of the nose, as in the reference
example_answers.subject.expression: a closed-mouth half-smile with the gaze engaged toward camera, chin down a few degrees
character.invariant: facial geometry: jaw shape, interocular distance, nose bridge width
skin tone and micro-texture from the identity reference
every mole, freckle and asymmetry declared in subject.preserved_marks
hairstyle and any stray strands visible on the identity reference
character.variable: pose and hand position now hold the object reference at waist height
expression allowed to shift within the closed-mouth range
wardrobe visible below the chest may vary from the identity reference
